heading: Fish and wildlife habitat; mitigation of losses
lead: Effective October 1, 1979, and to such extent and in such amounts as are provided in advance in appropriate 1 Acts, in order to provide measures determined by the Secretary of the Interior to be appropriated to mitigate loss of fish and wildlife habitat associated with other measures taken under this subchapter:

tree.heading: Appropriation of funds; acquisition and disposal of lands; facilities undertakings; funds restriction for non-Federal facilities

children.text: acquire lands by purchase, eminent domain, or exchange;
dispose of land, facilities, and equipment;
construct, operate, maintain, and make replacements of facilities: Provided, however, That no funds will be provided for operation, maintenance, or replacement of non-Federal facilities.

tree.heading: Nonreimbursable costs
tree.text: All costs authorized by this section are nonreimbursable.
